answer_1.quote: We present SQuALITY, a long-input dataset for abstractive question-focused summarization.
answer_1.outputs: abstractive summaries in response to questions about short stories

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the summaries with ROUGE and METEOR, standard automatic metrics for summarization. We also evaluate with a RoBERTa-large based version of BERTScore...

answer_4.quote: We accompany automatic evaluation of the baseline systems with human evaluation. We ask workers to rate the quality of outputs from BART and BART+DPR on the test data.
answer_4.guideline: Workers rate each summary for three properties: correctness, coverage, and overall quality. Each property is rated on a scale from 1-100...
